records.jp: 愛央ちゃんって普段から料理はするの？
records.en_original: Do you cook often, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you cook often, Ao?
records.en: Do you cook often, Ao-chan?

records.jp: いやー、全然。<CR>家庭科の授業でやったくらいかなあ
records.en_original: Nope, never. Home ec class is pretty much the only experience I have with it.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope, never. Home ec class is pretty much the only experience I have with it.
records.en: Nope, never. Home ec class<CR>is pretty much the only experience I have with it.

records.jp: こころの学校でもあった？　調理実習
records.en_original: Did you have cooking class at your school, Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you have cooking class at your school, Kokoro?
records.en: Did you have cooking class at your school, Kokoro?

records.jp: うん、あったよ。<CR>食材は学校で育ててた野菜とか使って……
records.en_original: Yeah! We grew ingredients in the school's vegetable garden.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! We grew ingredients in the school's vegetable garden.
records.en: Yeah! We grew<CR>ingredients in the school's vegetable garden.

records.jp: へー！　自分たちで育てた野菜ってこと？<CR>なんか本格的だねえ
records.en_original: Wow! Home-grown vegetables! That's the real deal!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow! Home-grown vegetables! That's the real deal!
records.en: Wow! Home-grown vegetables! That's<CR>the real deal!

records.jp: お米もご近所さんのたんぼで作ったのを<CR>譲ってもらって……
records.en_original: We also got some rice from a farmer nearby.
records.en_auxiliary: We also got some rice from a farmer nearby.
records.en: We were also given rice<CR>grown in a neighbor’s field...

records.jp: できたあとは、地域の人たちも試食に来たり……
records.en_original: When we finished, everyone in the neighborhood all came by to taste what we made.
records.en_auxiliary: When we finished, everyone in the neighborhood all came by to taste what we made.
records.en: After it was ready, people from the community would come taste it too...

records.jp: な、なんか……。<CR>授業っていうより、町内会のイベントみたい
records.en_original: Sounds more like a town-wide event than a class...
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds more like a town-wide event than a class...
records.en: Sounds more like<CR>a town-wide event than a class...

records.jp: まあ、そんな感じかも
records.en_original: Yeah, you might be right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you might be right.
records.en: Yeah, you might be right.

records.jp: そうやって地域のみんなが集まったりするのって<CR>なんか楽しそう！
records.en_original: Everyone around town coming together, that sounds like a lot of fun!
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone around town coming together, that sounds like a lot of fun!
records.en: Everyone around town coming together, that sounds<CR>like a lot of fun!

records.jp: うーん。<CR>でも、色々気もつかうから、結構疲れちゃうよ
records.en_original: Mm, it is, but it's also a lot of work having to talk with everyone and making sure they all get fed.
records.en_auxiliary: Mm, it is, but it's also a lot of work having to talk with everyone and making sure they all get fed.
records.en: Mm, it is,<CR>but it's also a lot of work having to talk with everyone and making sure they all get fed.

records.jp: ふーん、そういうもんなんだ
records.en_original: Huh, I guess that does sound like a lot.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, I guess that does sound like a lot.
records.en: Huh, I guess that does sound like a lot.

records.jp: もちろん、みんな優しかったけどね
records.en_original: Though don't get me wrong, everyone is great.
records.en_auxiliary: Though don't get me wrong, everyone is great.
records.en: Though don't get me wrong, everyone is great.

records.jp: それって、なんかすごく気つかっちゃいそうだね。<CR>料理に失敗したら大変だし
records.en_original: I'd be nervous with all those people, like what if I messed up the recipe?
records.en_auxiliary: I'd be nervous with all those people, like what if I messed up the recipe?
records.en: That sounds like it would make you really self-conscious.<CR>It would be awful if the cooking went wrong.

records.jp: そうなんだよね……。<CR>みんなが味見するまですっごく緊張した
records.en_original: Exactly. I was always nervous until everyone had gotten a taste.
records.en_auxiliary: Exactly. I was always nervous until everyone had gotten a taste.
records.en: Exactly. I was always<CR>nervous until everyone had gotten a taste.

records.jp: 一応、みんな喜んで食べてくれてたから、<CR>ホッとしたんだけど……
records.en_original: It was nice when everyone said they liked it, though.
records.en_auxiliary: It was nice when everyone said they liked it, though.
records.en: Everyone did eat it happily, at least,<CR>so that was a relief...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんの学校の調理実習って、<CR>どんな感じだったの？
records.en_original: What was your school's cooking class like, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What was your school's cooking class like, Ao?
records.en: What was your school's cooking<CR>class like, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 私のとこは、普通にスーパーで買ってきたりしてたよ。<CR>班のみんなで買い出しに行ったり
records.en_original: We always just went to the supermarket for ingredients. We'd all go with our groups to buy everything.
records.en_auxiliary: We always just went to the supermarket for ingredients. We'd all go with our groups to buy everything.
records.en: At my school, we just bought things at the supermarket.<CR>Everyone in the group would go shopping together.

records.jp: それも楽しそう
records.en_original: That sounds like fun too.
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds like fun too.
records.en: That sounds like fun too.

records.jp: わたしのいた学校だと、近くのスーパーまで<CR>何キロって感じだったし……
records.en_original: The closest supermarket to my school was a few kilometers...
records.en_auxiliary: The closest supermarket to my school was a few kilometers...
records.en: The closest supermarket to my school<CR>was a few kilometers...

records.jp: ちょっとした遠足だねそれは……
records.en_original: That's quite the trek...
records.en_auxiliary: That's quite the trek...
records.en: That's quite the trek...

records.jp: よく失敗してたなあ……<CR>うちの班、みんな料理ベタだったから大変だったよ
records.en_original: Everyone in my group was awful at cooking. It was mistake after mistake.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone in my group was awful at cooking. It was mistake after mistake.
records.en: Everyone in my group was<CR>awful at cooking. It was mistake after mistake.

records.jp: こころが一緒の班だったらよかったのに
records.en_original: If only we could have had someone like you.
records.en_auxiliary: If only we could have had someone like you.
records.en: I wish you had been in my group, Kokoro.

records.jp: ふふ。わたしも、愛央ちゃんと一緒の班で<CR>調理実習してみたかったな
records.en_original: Hehe. Taking a cooking class together does sound like a lot of fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. Taking a cooking class together does sound like a lot of fun.
records.en: Hehe. I wish I could have done cooking practice<CR>in the same group as you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: せっかくだし、今度一緒に何か作ってみる？
records.en_original: Why don't we cook together sometime soon, then?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we cook together sometime soon, then?
records.en: Why don't we cook together sometime soon, then?

records.jp: え、でも私戦力にならないよ……？
records.en_original: I'll probably only get in your way...
records.en_auxiliary: I'll probably only get in your way...
records.en: I'll probably only get in your way...

records.jp: 大丈夫。一緒にやることに意味があるんだから。<CR>作るなら何がいいかな？
records.en_original: Don't worry. The point of it is to have fun together. What should we make?
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. The point of it is to have fun together. What should we make?
records.en: Don't worry. The point of it is to have fun together.<CR>What should we make?

records.jp: じゃあ、こころの好物で！
records.en_original: Let's make your favorite food!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's make your favorite food!
records.en: Then let us make your favorite food!

records.jp: わたしの好物かあ……。<CR>うーん、いっぱいあって一つに絞れないなあ
records.en_original: My favorite? Hmm... There's so many, it's hard to narrow it down to just one.
records.en_auxiliary: My favorite? Hmm... There's so many, it's hard to narrow it down to just one.
records.en: My favorite? Hmm... There's<CR>so many, it's hard to narrow it down to just one.

records.jp: じゃあ、思いつく限り全部作っちゃう？
records.en_original: Then, we'll make everything you can think of!
records.en_auxiliary: Then, we'll make everything you can think of!
records.en: Then should we make everything you can think of?

records.jp: わたしは嬉しいけど、そんなに作れる？<CR>愛央ちゃんが大変じゃない？
records.en_original: That would be great, but are you sure? Do you think you could handle that?
records.en_auxiliary: That would be great, but are you sure? Do you think you could handle that?
records.en: That would make me happy, but can you really make that much?<CR>Wouldn't it be too hard for you, Ao-chan?

records.jp: ……ごめん、多分無理だわ
records.en_original: ...No, you're probably right. It's probably a bit much before.
records.en_auxiliary: ...No, you're probably right. It's probably a bit much before.
records.en: ...Sorry. That is probably impossible.

records.jp: それじゃあ、私の好物で！
records.en_original: Let's go with my favorite food!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's go with my favorite food!
records.en: Let's go with my favorite food!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんの好物って？
records.en_original: And what would that be?
records.en_auxiliary: And what would that be?
records.en: What's your favorite food, Ao-chan?

records.jp: うーん……唐揚げかな。<CR>衣がカリカリのやつ！
records.en_original: Hmm... I'm thinking fried chicken. Extra crispy!
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I'm thinking fried chicken. Extra crispy!
records.en: Hmm... Karaage, maybe.<CR>The kind with really crispy coating!

records.jp: いいね。わたしも好き。<CR>……あ、でもわたしは衣はしっとりの方が好き
records.en_original: Yum, good choice. Though, extra crispy isn't my favorite.
records.en_auxiliary: Yum, good choice. Though, extra crispy isn't my favorite.
records.en: Yum, good choice.<CR>Though, extra crispy isn't my favorite.

records.jp: な、こんなところで派閥争いが……。<CR>でも、私は譲る気はないよ！
records.en_original: Wha—?! A challenger?! I won't be backing down, you hear!
records.en_auxiliary: Wha—?! A challenger?! I won't be backing down, you hear!
records.en: A factional dispute, here of all places...<CR>But I have no intention of yielding!

records.jp: じゃあ、どっちも作ろっか
records.en_original: Why don't we just make both?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we just make both?
records.en: Why don't we just make both?

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
